examples.en: I'm sticking with Chen Junsheng for life. When he married me he said, don't work—he'll provide for me forever.
examples.zh: 反正我这辈子赖定陈俊生了。他娶我的时候说，叫我不要工作，他养我一辈子。

examples.en: It later proved true: in those very days, Chen Junsheng was completely rewriting my fate and this family's.
examples.zh: 后来证实，就是在那几天里，我和这个家的命运正在被陈俊生彻底改变。

tags: 子君前夫，辰星咨询公司精英，出轨凌玲后离婚
